### Creating a Legacy: Preparing the Stones
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/article-library/creating-a-legacy-preparing-the-stones
Passage: Joshua 4:6-7
Points:
- Establishing physical memorials requires intentional effort and ongoing commitment.
- Tangible markers prevent believers from forgetting the Lord's mighty acts and character.
- Visual reminders redirect our focus from past failures and trials to God's faithfulness.
- Parents must proactively impart spiritual truths to their children through meaningful memories.

### How Traditions Mend Anxiety
Author: Jessica Smartt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-june-7-2019.html
Passage: Joshua 4:6-7
Points:
- Persistent anxieties can be dispelled by recalling specific ways God previously delivered us.
- Because people naturally forget, intentional traditions serve as modern memorial stones.
- Family rituals and spiritual habits ground the soul amid busy schedules and distractions.
- Reflecting on God's past care gives us confidence that He will sustain us today.

### Constructing Memorials
Author: Robin Dugall
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-jan-12-2011-11643989.html
Passage: Joshua 4:6-7
Points:
- Everyday objects can serve as personal reminders of Christ's healing and grace.
- Physical symbols carry true spiritual power only through the testimonies attached to them.
- Visible memorials create natural opportunities to share what God has accomplished in our lives.
- Believers benefit from surrounding themselves with tangible signs of answered prayers and commitments.

### Remember My Past Blessings
Author: Leading The Way
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-may-14.html
Passage: Joshua 4:1-3, 6-7
Points:
- Treating God only as a provider of requests weakens prayer and reveals ingratitude.
- Forgetting divine aid in past difficulties leads to grumbling and spiritual blindness.
- God directed His people to build physical memorials because He knows humanity's forgetful nature.
- Recalling past provisions inspires genuine praise and restores bold confidence in God.
